profile.legalName: Black Cultural Zone Community Development Corporation
profile.summary: A nonprofit community development corporation founded in 2019 in East Oakland. It is the implementing arm of the East Oakland Black Cultural Zone Collaborative and works on neighborhood, commercial and cultural development centered on the area's Black communities, including cultural events and business support.
